notes: The tuition quote from the DAAD page states there are no tuition fees per semester for this programme. The university's own Study Costs page states there are no tuition fees for Bachelor's or Master's programs at German state universities, but it also mentions a semester fee (322.06 EUR for summer semester 2022) covering administrative costs and a semester ticket; that semester fee is a general institution-wide figure, not programme-specific, so it was not included as tuition. The application deadline September 1 is given without a year; the value uses 2025-09-01 as a placeholder because the intake year is not explicitly stated. The pages state English proficiency certificates are required for this English-taught programme; the quote 'The following certificates are recognized: TOEFL (minimum 80 points; internet-based test)' lists TOEFL and corresponding quotes exist for IELTS and Cambridge, so acceptedTests includes toefl and ielts but not cambridge as that is not one of the allowed test ISO codes.
